statement: After matching to actual valid 16-nt genomic address space and observed per-genome MOP occurrence weights, FOUNDATION_RUNTIME (tRNA+rRNA+other_noncoding_RNA) will contain more MOP occurrences than expected.
support_condition: observed/expected >1 and one-sided 20,000-replicate Monte Carlo tail <=0.05; strong support <=0.01.
contamination_boundary: Frozen after v0.0.14 descriptive classification and before any genome-wide valid-16nt background counts or enrichment ratios were calculated.
